ios.desc:
Voice2Mail is a practical app that allows you to create voice 
recordings with just one single click. After recording, the voice file 
will be emailed to yourself and/or others.

Voice2Mail is perfect for recording ideas and taking voice notes while 
you're in the hurry. It allows you recording notes without having to 
look to the screen and without having to type anything.

+++ This offers you Voice2Mail +++
- Record voice memos with one click
- Automatic dispatch of notes

+++ Premium-Features+++
- Maximum record length adjustable
- Listen and delete memos directly in the app
- Location can be transmitted optionally
- Upload with WLAN connection adjustable

Use the dictation machine app to record your ideas as voice messages and listen to them later as MP3 in your e-mail. So you will never forget spontaneous ideas or dates!

Even if you do not have a signal, you can use Voice2Mail to record a voice memo. The program will send you the note as soon as you are online.
On request the location of your recording can also be transmitted. You can listen to your memos directly in the app and delete them if necessary.
